images.prompt: Vertical epic cinematic film still, photorealistic, anamorphic lens, dramatic volumetric light, warm amber and gold color grade, fine film grain, shallow depth of field. Upper half of the frame is dark empty night sky; the subject sits low in the lower half. Animals with natural correct anatomy. No text, letters, logos or watermarks. A large owl perched on a low dark branch in the lower half of the frame, its whole head, face and huge round glaring eyes fully visible, staring down at the forest floor, a rising moon low behind it.
